content.title: DNOW Q3 Deep Dive: MRC Global Merger and Midstream Expansion Shape Outlook
content.summary: Energy and industrial distributor DistributionNOW (NYSE:DNOW) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 4.6% year on year to $634 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.26 per share was 11.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.title: DNOW (DNOW) Profit Margin Drops Sharply, Undermining Value Narrative in Latest Earnings
content.summary: DNOW (DNOW) reported a net profit margin of 3.4%, down noticeably from 9.5% in the prior year. While the company faced negative earnings over the past year, DNOW has posted earnings growth of 65.3% per year on average over the past five years. Forecasts call for 7.9% annual earnings growth ahead. For investors, these updates set the scene for a business that continues to deliver long-term profitability gains, even as near-term margins feel some pressure. See our full analysis for DNOW.
